LESSON: MYSELF

Grade: Grade 2
Subject: HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Creation
Topic 1.1: Myself

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Myself. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: Where do insects live?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. report incidents to the authorities in school for attention
2. appreciate everyone in school as God’s creation any unpleasant incident by anybody within the school. 1.2 Pancha Mahabhoot (Elements of Nature): insects as Paramatma’s creation (6 lessons) Earth as God’s creation.

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. report incidents to the authorities in school for attention
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to report incidents to the authorities in school for attention. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

2. appreciate everyone in school as God’s creation any unpleasant incident by anybody within the school. 1.2 Pancha Mahabhoot (Elements of Nature): insects as Paramatma’s creation (6 lessons) Earth as God’s creation.
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to appreciate everyone in school as God’s creation any unpleasant incident by anybody within the school. 1.2 Pancha Mahabhoot (Elements of Nature): insects as Paramatma’s creation (6 lessons) Earth as God’s creation. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Name one place of worship in your community and say how people show respect there.

Example 2: Practise sitting quietly for a short prayer or reflection.

Example 3: Tell your parent one good habit you learned from this lesson.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Read the examples above again. Underline two new words or ideas about Myself.
2. Explain Myself to a parent or classmate using your own words and one Kenyan example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Myself.
4. Show that you can: report incidents to the authorities in school for attention
5. Complete the Work to do section, then attempt the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after you finish.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Myself. Use examples from your school, home, or market.
2. Answer this question in your exercise book: Where do insects live?
3. Make a short oral presentation (about one minute) to your parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 8: REMEMBER

1. report incidents to the authorities in school for attention
2. appreciate everyone in school as God’s creation any unpleasant incident by anybody within the school. 1.2 Pancha Mahabhoot (Elements of Nature): insects as Paramatma’s creation (6 lessons) Earth as God’s creation.

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Learner lesson
